decisionScope: This record is the platform-internal, digest-bound approval decision for the supply-chain evidence chain only. It is NOT a deployment: the candidate remains undeployed, production Argo CD / GitOps were not touched, and any production switch requires a separate explicit approval.
residualNotes: This approval covers the supply-chain evidence chain for this digest only. The candidate remains undeployed (the running production index is still sha256:489cb821573ff1f98edd846d5949d74bf3391b24e2f1fe5bcfb71c6be0793137, re-verified on devops during this round), and a production switch (Argo CD / GitOps) requires a separate explicit approval that was not part of this round.

Platform-level formal-path gaps remain open and are NOT closed by this record: the manager-v2 SBOM executor cannot produce container-image SBOMs (the verified controlled-run descriptive binding was used), and the SBOM Policy accepts CycloneDX 1.6 only while generated image SBOMs are 1.7 (decision item U6; Policy unchanged).

No DSSE statement jobs ran for build #7 (unlike build #2 / petclinic-ci #270 for the previous candidate); provenance relies on the Jenkins build record and the in-index buildx SLSA attestations, as recorded in the chain.

The Manager formal scan entry (entry.py scan-v1) still pins the previous candidate in projects.json; this round's gate evidence is the controlled rescan, following the B1 precedent. Re-pinning the formal entry is a separate change.

The signature attachments exist in two forms: sigstore bundle referrers (cosign v3 native) and legacy .sig tags (the only form the live Kyverno policy consumes). Both were produced by the platform signing identity; the blob signatures over the exact manifest bytes are sealed in this bundle set.
satisfied: Build provenance VERIFIED for the exact candidate: Jenkins petclinic-candidate-build #7 SUCCESS on the fix commit 318d479fb458ff229d0e10ed99ae7317f7427625 (build.xml evidence), and both buildx attestation vcs:revision fields equal the same commit

Dual-arch controlled Trivy rescan with a same-day refreshed vulnerability DB: CRITICAL 0 / HIGH 0 on both architectures; CVE-2026-109518 absent on both; fixed apt and libapt-pkg7.0 version 3.2.1ubuntu0.1 detected in both images
SBOM -> digest binding VERIFIED this round (independent verification 29/29, including cross-candidate and cross-project negatives); provenance assessment sealed with the binding bundle

Real Cosign signatures by the platform identity: blob signatures over the exact index and both child manifest bytes (3 positives verified, 5 negatives rejected) and Harbor-side signature attachments in place (sigstore bundle referrers verified by cosign, and legacy .sig tags written by the scoped cosign-push robot 251)

Kyverno signature admission proven live against the current policy: the candidate is ALLOWED on server dry-run and was really created (then deleted); signed fixture allowed; unsigned and wrong-key fixtures denied
